simpleMeans: One status board, one job per calendar day, optional CEP-5 draft (print for paper sign) on Alabama OSS install/repair only.
designSystem: AlignUI (https://www.alignui.com/) — React + Tailwind. Production UI only from AlignUI; prototypes are not the system. Primary #E56515; see docs/brand/palette.json.

access.modes: Same app; Office vs Crew landings
access.crewIdentity: Session picker: which person. Crew sees only jobs assigned to that person.

jobs.types: See job-types.json. All field jobs on one board.

cep5Draft.when: Job type oss_install_new or oss_repair and site in Alabama
cep5Draft.prefillFrom: cep5-field-map.json fields with source office or lhd (copied, not invented)
cep5Draft.firstFieldSlice: photos and notes; layout sketch later
cep5Draft.signature: Wet sign on paper after print or PDF export. No in-app signature.

quoteSiteHandoff.rule: A public quote funnel (if a client has one) is not Cimitri. Do not fuse quote leads with job + CEP-5 records without an explicit accepted-quote to job step.

success.office: Can answer who is on what job, which truck, what status, from the board.
success.cep5: On a finished Alabama OSS install, identity / permit / tank fields are mostly filled from the job; crew adds photos and notes; licensee wet-signs a printed PDF.
success.crew: Status update in under a minute.
success.nonSeptic: Vault, pump, grease, tank-only jobs never dead-end in CEP-5.

users.goal: Schedule, assign, watch the board, close jobs, produce CEP-5 drafts without hunting paper.
See today’s jobs, tap status, capture as-built CEP-5 facts when the job needs them.
Attest and sign CEP-5. May not be the person who dug. Views vs permissions still undecided.
Correct names on CEP-5 vs invoice vs site contact—handled by office data, not a portal.

outOfV1: filing CEP-2 / CEP-3 for the owner
layout sketch in first CEP-5 slice
one job record spanning multiple calendar days

buildSequence.must: Shop login, people, vehicles, customers/sites, jobs, office board, crew assigned-only today/week, status taps, PWA
buildSequence.should: CEP-5 draft prefill, photos/notes, print/PDF for paper sign
buildSequence.later: Sketch, typed as-built fields, per-person accounts, digital sign, multi-day job records
